_doc: EARL'S BACK ROOM — the prestige board. Finishing the Midnight Race (spine ch12) or any companion arc earns a Prestige Mark; marks spend here on cosmetic + gentle-utility rewards. Data-driven like spine.json: this file is the CATALOG, Prestige.js is the engine. Doctrine: no dark patterns — prices are flat, nothing expires, nothing is time-limited, no reward gates quest completion or race outcomes. Total earnable marks (6) < total catalog cost (9) — choices matter, hoarding is impossible, FOMO is impossible.

paintSchemes.label: Rust Sunset Paint
paintSchemes.desc: Orange fading to deep red, like the yard at closing time.
paintSchemes.earlLine: Rust never looked that good on purpose before.

paintSchemes.label: Circuit Green Paint
paintSchemes.desc: The exact green of a happy circuit board.
paintSchemes.earlLine: Board-green. Magma will think it's one of its own.

paintSchemes.label: Midnight Blue Paint
paintSchemes.desc: For the bot that runs the 11:58 watch.
paintSchemes.earlLine: Same blue as the sky at the candlelight corner.

paintSchemes.label: Candlelight Gold Paint
paintSchemes.desc: Warm gold, one beacon's worth. You know the one.
paintSchemes.earlLine: Careful with that one. Some corners remember it.

yardDecorations.label: Tire Plant Garden
yardDecorations.desc: Stacked tires, soil, and whatever Juno's swarm seeds in them.
yardDecorations.earlLine: First garden this yard's ever grown. Don't tell the inspectors.

yardDecorations.label: Flag Collection
yardDecorations.desc: Every waypoint flag you've ever planted, on one proud pole.
yardDecorations.earlLine: Twenty-six years of corners, on one pole. Looks about right.

lanternColors.label: Warm Amber Lantern
lanternColors.desc: Soft amber headlamp light. Kind to night eyes.
lanternColors.earlLine: Amber's easier on the eyes than flood-white. Ask any owl.

botSlots.label: Second Bot Slot (Back Room favor)
botSlots.desc: A second ScrapBot without needing the Level 5 Engineer skill. Comfort, not power — a bot is a bot.
botSlots.earlLine: Box M had a cradle in it. Turns out it was for a second somebody.

earlBoardLines: Back room's been locked twenty-six years. Now it ain't. Don't make me regret that.
Everything in here's earned, not bought. Mo keeps count. Mo don't lie.
Ain't fancy back here. But it's yours if you worked for it.
earlFirstMarkLine: Well look at that. First mark. Mo's writing your name down in the good book.
earlCantAffordLine: Not yet. That's alright — it'll keep. Ain't going anywhere.

earlPurchaseLines.paint: New coat of paint. Wear it proud, keep it clean.
earlPurchaseLines.decor: Nice touch. Place needed a little more you in it.
earlPurchaseLines.lantern: Good light. A yard's only as warm as its lantern.
earlPurchaseLines.botSlot: Two bots now. Twice the trouble, twice the help. Mo approves.
